jobs.description: Work ScheduleStandard Office Hours (40/wk)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionAs part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.The BioProduction Group (BPG) provides the technology, materials and services to develop and produce life-changing medicines efficiently, sustainably and cost-effectively. Through our scientific expertise, differentiated innovations and global network, we help customers advance biologics, vaccines and advanced therapies from development to commercialization. With flagship products like the DynaDrive bioreactor and DynaCellect Magnetic Separation System, BPG supports some of the most innovative breakthrough medicines, helping bring treatments to patients faster and advancing Thermo Fisher Scientific’s mission to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.Our Thermo Fisher Scientific site in Darmstadt is a key hub for the marketing, sales, service and support of our life sciences products. Home to around 300 colleagues, including approximately 120 field-based employees, the site brings together inside sales, our EMEA Customer Contact Center and a dedicated laboratory for customer training. From Darmstadt, we support customers across scientific research with a portfolio of more than 50,000 products, including solutions from leading brands such as Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Gibco and Ion Torrent.Discover Impactful WorkJoin Thermo Fisher Scientific as an Inside Sales Representative (m/f/d) Bioprocessing and be part of our mission to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. In this role, you'll generate sales growth through virtual and digital channels while building strong relationships with customers across academic, biotech, pharma, clinical and industrial markets. You'll promote and sell our comprehensive portfolio of scientific products and services, using consultative selling skills to understand customer needs and provide optimal solutions. Working in a collaborative environment, you'll develop and execute strategic sales plans, manage customer relationships through our CRM system, and partner with cross-functional teams to achieve business targets. This position offers excellent career development opportunities within a global leader in serving science.A Day in the Life:Generate sales growth through virtual and digital channels while building strong relationships with customers across academic, biotech, pharma, clinical and industrial markets. Promote and sell our comprehensive portfolio of scientific products and services, using consultative selling skills to understand customer needs and provide optimal solutions.What to expect:- Develop and execute strategic sales plans- Build and maintain strong customer relationships- Manage customer relationships through our CRM system- Use consultative selling skills to understand customer needs and provide optimal solutions- Promote and sell our comprehensive portfolio of scientific products and services- Partner with cross-functional teams to achieve business target- Travel 10-25% for customer meetings and internal eventsKeys to Success:Education- Bachelor’s degree with laboratory and/or research experience- Preferred Fields of Study: Life Sciences, Biology, Chemistry or related scientific fieldExperience- Previous Sales Experience is an advantage but not required- Experience with scientific products/instruments preferred but not requiredKnowledge, Skills, Abilities- Strong consultative selling and relationship building skills- Proficiency with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) and Microsoft Office suite- Ability to develop and maintain deep product and technical knowledge- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail- Effective at working both independently and collaboratively- Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities- Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical capabilities- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with fluency in both English and GermanBenefits:We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com/)Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of  , color, religion, ___ ,   orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.Your Role:At the intersection of science, strategy, and commercial impact, this role places you at the heart of some of the most consequential decisions in healthcare drug development and commercialization. As an Associate Director within the Global Strategic Insights function, you will serve as a trusted thought partner to therapy area commercial teams — translating complex market dynamics into clear, actionable intelligence that shapes how healthcare assets are launched, grown, and managed across major global markets.This role will interact primarily with the Rare Tumor and Specialty Therapy Area teams, partnering closely with colleagues who are driving some of the most strategically significant assets in the portfolio.You will own the end-to-end delivery of insights across one or more GSI disciplines (primary market research, competitive intelligence, or strategic forecasting), ensuring every recommendation is grounded in rigorous analysis and directly informs critical business decisions.Working with cross-functional partners across commercial strategy, market access and pricing, other GSI functions, and regional insights teams, you will drive insights that elevate decision quality at critical stages of the asset lifecycle.Who You Are :- A degree in life sciences, business, economics, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience — is required.- 5 or more years of experience in at least one global strategic insights discipline — primary market research, competitive intelligence, data analytics, or strategic forecasting — ideally within the pharmaceutical or biopharma industry.- You have designed and led insights and KPI workstreams for in-market or launch assets, with at least 2 years of direct experience across pre-launch, launch, and post-launch phases.- You hold deep expertise in one or more of the following: qualitative and quantitative primary market research (study design, discussion guide development, strategic recommendations); global competitive intelligence (trial monitoring, congress coverage, strategic simulation); or topline forecasting (model building, opportunity assessment, scenario analysis).- You have global experience across two or more major markets — such as the US, China, EU4 and UK, or Japan — and bring a nuanced understanding of how market dynamics differ across regions.- You work effectively across functions, with a solid understanding of how commercial strategy, market access and pricing, and regional insights teams each contribute to asset success.- You are comfortable navigating the full medicine lifecycle — from proof-of-concept through in-market management — and understand how insights activities evolve at each stage.- You communicate complex findings with clarity and confidence, translating analytical outputs into compelling narratives that resonate with senior stakeholders and drive informed decisions.- English fluent, additional languages are a plusWhat we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!
